answer_1.quote: We prompt an LLM to generate personas. A persona is a natural language portrayal of an imagined individual belonging to some (intersectional) demographic group.

answer_2.quote: We use the Fightin' Words method... with the informative Dirichlet prior, first computing the weighted log-odds ratios... using the z-score to measure the statistical significance... We also use several other methods as robustness checks... Classification... Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD)... stereotype lexicons... sentiment of the generated personas using the VADER... sentiment analyzer.
